title: A student applies and pays the Deposit; a Manager confirms the transfer
pre: Demo stage A; accounts se220001 and manager01 (@fpt.edu.vn)
steps: Sign in as se220001; Registration › Start application
Choose the Term, Room Type 4-bed, Room Tier Standard; fill the contact details and consents; submit
Payments › open the Deposit Invoice; transfer with the shown content; press I have transferred and enter the bank reference
Sign in as manager01; Payments › Payment confirmations › select the claim › Confirm
expected: The Application is Awaiting Deposit, then Submitted after the confirmation; the Deposit Invoice is Paid; the student gets a notification

title: A Manager rejects a payment claim that is not on the bank statement
pre: Demo stage A; a claim waiting (se220008); manager01
steps: Sign in as manager01; Payments › Payment confirmations
Select the claim of se220008 › Reject; write the reason
Sign in as se220008; Payments › open the Invoice
expected: The claim is Rejected with the reason; the Invoice is Unpaid again with its remaining time; the student is told why

title: A Manager requests a registration period and the Admin publishes the Term
pre: Demo stage 0; accounts manager01 and admin01
steps: Sign in as manager01; Period requests › Request a registration period: dates, Blocks, prices; send
Sign in as admin01; Terms › New term from the request
Go through the seven steps of the wizard; Publish
expected: The Term is Published with its prices and rules fixed; the request is Done; the announcement appears on the students' board

title: The wizard refuses a timeline out of order
pre: Demo stage 0; admin01; a Term draft
steps: Terms › New term › Timeline
Set the registration closing date before its opening date; Save and continue
expected: The step is not saved; the wrong field is named with its message; the next step stays locked

title: A resident asks to extend the stay and a Manager approves it
pre: Demo stage A (requests window open); accounts se210002 and manager01
steps: Sign in as se210002; Requests › ask to extend the stay for the next Term
Sign in as manager01; Term transition › Open requests › approve the extension
expected: The request is approved; the next-Term Allocation on the same Bed continues; the student is notified

title: A request after the filing deadline is refused
pre: Demo stage B (filing closed at M3); a resident such as se210004
steps: Sign in as the resident; Requests › New room change for the next Term; submit
expected: The request is refused with the message that filing for the next Term is closed

title: A student reports a problem; Staff fix it; the student confirms
pre: Demo stage A; accounts se200009 and staffa02
steps: Sign in as se200009; Requests › New maintenance request: category, place, title, description, a photo; submit
Sign in as staffa02; Maintenance › open the request › Start › Resolve
Sign in as se200009; confirm the fix
expected: The request is routed to staffa02 with its SLA due time, goes In progress, Resolved, then Closed

title: A Manager reassigns a request past its time limit
pre: Demo stage A; MR-000338 past its 72-hour limit; manager01
steps: Sign in as manager01; Overdue requests › open MR-000338
Choose another Staff member, write a note › Reassign
expected: The request has the new assignee and the note in its history; the new assignee is notified

title: Staff import the month's meter readings and bill the Rooms
pre: Demo stage A; staffa01; the sample readings file (Admin › System › Demo data)
steps: Sign in as staffa01; Meter readings › Import the sample file
Check the flagged values; Close period and bill
Sign in as a resident of Block A; Payments
expected: Every Room of Block A has its readings; Utility Invoices are issued, each resident's share split by days

title: A reading below the previous one is refused
steps: Meter readings › type an electricity reading lower than the previous reading of the Room; save
expected: The reading is not saved; the field says it cannot be below the previous reading

title: A new resident receives the Room with the check-in inventory
pre: Demo stage D; accounts ss220055 and staffa01
steps: Sign in as ss220055; My room › Check-in inventory › Start check-in inventory
Answer each item and the meters; submit
Sign in as staffa01; Check-in inventories › open the report › make it final
expected: The door code is shown after the start; the report is Submitted, then Final; the student is resident

title: Check-out of an overdue resident with damage the student disputes
pre: Demo stage D; se210003 did not leave by the deadline; staffa01, manager01
steps: Sign in as staffa01; Check-out › se210003: record each item, a damage and the final meter readings
Sign in as se210003; disagree with the charge
Sign in as manager01; decide the charge
expected: The charge waits for the Manager; after the decision the Utility Deposit is refunded less the Utility share and the charges

title: A Family Day: guests registered, checked in and out
pre: Demo stage A; manager01, a resident of Block A, staffa01
steps: Sign in as manager01; Family Days › New Family Day for Block A with time slots and places; publish
Sign in as the resident; Family Day › register two guests for a slot
Sign in as staffa01; Family Days › Desk › scan each pass; check in, then check out
expected: Each guest gets a pass; the slot's places go down; the desk records Inside, then Left

title: Staff cannot check out an overdue guest the student has not confirmed
pre: The Family Day of ST-13 after its slot ended, one guest still inside
steps: Sign in as staffa01; Desk › send the reminder
Try to check the guest out before the student confirms
expected: The check-out is refused to Staff until the student confirms the guest is safe (a Manager may, with a note)

title: A Manager plans and sends next week's schedule
pre: Demo stage A; manager01 and staffa01
steps: Sign in as manager01; Staff › Work schedule › next week › Copy the week before › Send next week's schedule
Sign in as staffa01; My schedule › Next week
expected: The schedule is sent for every Block; staffa01 sees their shifts for next week

title: A change outside the shift asks for a confirmation and is recorded
pre: Demo stage A; staffa01 with no shift now
steps: Sign in as staffa01; change a record (for example start a maintenance request)
Confirm working outside the shift
Sign in as manager01; Staff › Staff activity
expected: The change is saved only after the confirmation; it is listed in Staff activity for the Managers
